short_description: Research-only panel-relative PGS signal for nonalcoholic fatty liver disease.
summary_note: This score estimates a cautious, research-only, reference-panel-relative genetic signal for nonalcoholic fatty liver disease.
what_it_measures: A polygenic score associated with Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease in PGS Catalog. It does not measure current symptoms, diagnosis, clinical state, lab values, medication response, or clinical risk for this user.
interpretation_template: Fatty-liver research signal is shown as a research-only genetic signal, not a medical result, diagnosis, screening result, medication/allergy decision, treatment recommendation, prevention recommendation, or lifestyle recommendation. {interpretation}
caution_text: Research-only genetic signal. This is not a diagnosis, medical advice, screening, medication/allergy guidance, treatment guidance, prevention guidance, or a substitute for a clinician or laboratory test. Results depend on raw-file coverage and the local reference panel.
limitations: This is not a diagnosis, medical advice, clinical screening, medication/allergy guidance, prevention guidance, or treatment guidance.
The score does not measure current symptoms, disease status, laboratory values, medication safety, allergy status, or future clinical risk for the user.
Reference distribution is built from local raw files and may be small or ancestry-biased.
No genotype imputation is used, so missing variants can affect the estimate.
Real health questions, symptoms, medication allergies, and laboratory testing require a qualified clinician.
confidence_note: Confidence depends on raw-file coverage and overlap with scoring variants; it is not clinical certainty.
reference_note: Reference panel: local empirical panel from available Autosomal raw files, excluding bot staging folders.
